# Vendored assets

- `mapbox-gl-rtl-text.js` — RTL text shaping plugin for MapLibre GL JS (Arabic/Hebrew glyph joining). Source: [@mapbox/mapbox-gl-rtl-text](https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-gl-rtl-text) (BSD-2-Clause). Vendored directly because the package's `exports` field blocks subpath imports of its prebuilt `dist` file from bundlers.
